review_scope: Local independent finite normal-EOS contract review; no remote, service or GPU operations.

tests.scope: In-memory fake HTTP finite off/on natural EOS, exact outputs/usages, mutation rejection, visible phase coverage, admission cancellation/reuse; no socket or GPU.
Unchanged BYIELD strict-length3072 off/on regression and coverage; in-memory fake HTTP only.

qualification_contract: Normal completed SSE with no error: length requires completion_tokens==fixed max budget; stop requires integer1..budget.
Actual completion_tokens equals native predicted_n; all three logical integer usage fields are consistent.
No reasoning/tool bytes or tool channel; nonempty visible answer remains required.
Exactly four resident lanes have visible content no later than each phase start and no earlier than each phase end; late HTTP terminal completion alone cannot qualify.
Both arms retain exact request hash, output/channel hashes, finish reason and actual prompt/completion/total counts.

Request bodies, fixture generation, budgets, sampling/seed/plan, calibration, stream client, old silence metrics and other suites are unchanged. Whole-case rate continues to use actual completed tokens.
limits: Old failed artifact remains failed; a fresh v6 paired run is required.
This is a harness-contract qualification, not an engine correctness or performance pass.
An exact matched finite cohort may compare elapsed time and gaps; unmatched actual work cannot support a speedup claim.
SSE content chunks are not token boundaries, and visible first/last bracketing does not prove uninterrupted GPU execution.
One pair does not establish a tail SLO or general workload improvement; actual100k first-use, correctness and repeated/reversed performance qualification remain separate.
